column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Hallelujah” is rendered “Praise the LORD!” and NKJV supplies “Him.”
Close to the Hebrew; לִסְגֻלָּתוֹ (“his treasured possession”) is rendered “His special treasure.”
Close to the Hebrew; נְשִׂאִים (“clouds, vapors”) is rendered “the vapors,” and “storehouses” “treasuries.”
Close to the Hebrew; זִכְרְךָ (“your remembrance”) is rendered “Your fame.”
Close to the Hebrew; יָדִין (“vindicates”) is rendered “will judge.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will be like them” is rendered “are like them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “house of the Levites” is rendered “house of Levi.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Hallelujah” is rendered “Praise the LORD!”
